Nursing Note, 2034-01-28, evening and night

At 19:30 the temperature rose to 39.4 °C and the blood pressure fell to 88/52. A 1-litre saline bolus brought it back to 106/64 by 20:30, and tocilizumab (8 mg/kg) followed at 20:45 once the physician had recorded grade 2 cytokine release syndrome. Oxygen saturation remained 97% on room air throughout.

The ICE screen at 22:15 was 10/10. The patient is talking with family, asked sensible questions about the fever, and is now trying to sleep.
